description: This file defines the AdminWatchlistOperationsService class, which extends WatchlistOperationsService to provide administrative operations for managing watchlist entries, including bulk deletion, individual deletion, adding entries by email or domain, dismissing reports, and auto-unlocking users after watchlist removal.

classes.name: AdminWatchlistOperationsService
classes.description: A service class providing administrative operations for managing watchlist entries, including bulk delete, delete, add by email, dismiss reports, and user unlock functionalities.

methods.name: getScope
methods.description: Returns the scope for watchlist operations, set to global with no specific organization.

methods.name: bulkDeleteWatchlistEntries
methods.description: Deletes multiple watchlist entries by IDs, with validation and error handling, and auto-unlocks users if applicable.

methods.name: deleteWatchlistEntry
methods.description: Deletes a single watchlist entry after validation, and unlocks user if the entry is a signup email.

methods.name: addToWatchlistByEmail
methods.description: Adds an email or domain to the watchlist, linking pending reports and updating their status.

methods.name: dismissReportByEmail
methods.description: Dismisses system reports associated with a specific email.

methods.name: unlockSignupUser
methods.description: Attempts to unlock a user account by email and sends verification email if successful.

methods.name: bulkDismissReportsByEmail
methods.description: Dismisses reports for multiple emails in bulk.
